name: Orbit Camera Basis Computation
definition: Computes an orthonormal camera basis (eye, forward, right, up) for an orbit camera looking at a target from a distance, oriented by yaw and pitch angles.
summary: Orbit Camera Basis Computation calculates an orthonormal camera basis from spherical angles, differing from standard look-at methods by deriving the eye position directly from parametric angles rather than accepting a pre-computed position.
